paragraphs: Alot of people will freak out and check this turn because they're afraid toget raised off the draw they picked up. It’s important to remember how difficult it is for Villain to make a flush. The only reasonable combos he could have are Qde- Jd, O&-Sh, Gh-5e& and 5&-4&. The rest of his range consists of K-x, 10-x, Q-J, and random floats. Hero can still generate a ton
of fold equity by betting this turn.
Pro tip: Check small suited aces to protect big pairs on ace high boards.
